build_module_MultiScaleDeformableAttenti: build a PyTorch C++/CUDA extension module for Multi-Scale Deformable Attention
build_extensions_get_extensions: build CppExtension or CUDAExtension modules from source files in the src directory
build_setup_package: build a setuptools package named MultiScaleDeformableAttention with CUDA support
build_cpp_extension_cpu: build a CPU-only CppExtension from C++ source files when CUDA is unavailable
build_cuda_extension_gpu: build a CUDAExtension with nvcc compile flags for FP16 support when CUDA is available
